```{r}
#load packages
library(hdrm)
library(tidyverse)
library(glmnet)
library(MASS)
library(knitr)

set.seed(12345)


#Simulation Settings

nsim <- 1000

n_values <- c(250, 500)
rho_values <- c(0, 0.35, 0.70)

p <- 20
p_nonzero <- 5

#True beta coefficients:
#X1-X5 are truly associated with Y
# X6-X20 are null variables
beta_true <- c(seq(0.5/3, 2.5/3, by = 0.5/3), rep(0, 15))

true_vars <- paste0("V", sprintf("%02d", 1:5))
null_vars <- paste0("V", sprintf("%02d", 6:20))

alpha_level <- 0.05
backward_alpha <- 0.15
```


```{r}
# Simulate one dataset

simulate_one_dataset <- function(n, rho) {
  
  dat <- gen_data(
    n = n,
    p = p,
    p1 = p_nonzero,
    beta = beta_true,
    family = "gaussian",
    corr = "exchangeable",
    rho = rho
  )
  
  X <- as.data.frame(dat$X)
  y <- dat$y
  
  simdat <- data.frame(y = y, X)
  
  return(simdat)
}


# Simulate datasets for Case 1 and Case 2

#Case 1: N = 250
#Case 2: N = 500
#For each case, simulate datasets under rho = 0, 0.35, 0.70

simulated_datasets <- list()

for(n_i in n_values) {
  
  for(rho_i in rho_values) {
    
    scenario_name <- paste0("n_", n_i, "_rho_", rho_i)
    
    simulated_datasets[[scenario_name]] <- vector("list", length = nsim)
    
    for(s in 1:nsim) {
      
      simulated_datasets[[scenario_name]][[s]] <- simulate_one_dataset(
        n = n_i,
        rho = rho_i
      )
    }
  }
}

#Inspect simulated datasets

names(simulated_datasets)

head(simulated_datasets[["n_250_rho_0"]][[1]])

dim(simulated_datasets[["n_250_rho_0"]][[1]])
dim(simulated_datasets[["n_500_rho_0"]][[1]])

lapply(simulated_datasets, function(x) dim(x[[1]]))
lapply(simulated_datasets, function(x) head(x[[1]][, 1:6]))


#check predictor correlations for one dataset per scenario

cor_checks <- lapply(simulated_datasets, function(x) {
  dat1 <- x[[1]]
  cor_mat <- cor(dat1[, -1])
  mean(cor_mat[upper.tri(cor_mat)])
})

cor_checks
```
